content_fields.title: Ensure that row-level security is correctly configured (PostgreSQL)
content_fields.description: Configure row-level security policies on the tables holding user data.
content_fields.guidance: Row-level security should be enabled on the user-scoped tables with policies that restrict each application role to the rows it owns, so a flaw in application code cannot expose another user's records.
content_fields.found: The migrations create tables with no row-level security, and the application connects as a single privileged role that any policy would bypass.
content_fields.missing: Database roles for the application's identities and the migration that would enable and define the policies.
content_fields.conclusion: Row-level security requires a database role model that the deployment does not have; it is a database design change owned by the database administrators.
content_fields.action: The database administration team should define the role model and row-level security policies.
